$comment: City of Mages Grimoire v1.8.0 structured-delta patch (2026-06-09). Two threads converge here: (1) the CANONICAL LATTICE ENCODING LOCK and the persona reseats it forces (the City had several figures misassigned under a corrupted bit-order), and (2) the new HORIZON DISTRICT — the cryptographic-durability / path-to-PQC workshop seeded from the ecdsa.fail benchmark in shor_mage/ and the sci-fi-future text *The Last Premine*. Merge into v1.7.1 to produce v1.8.0; re-pin to IPFS after the merge pass. Honest framing held throughout: resource estimation is a durability signal, not an attack; nothing claims ECDSA is practically broken or that anything is fully post-quantum safe.

canonical_lattice_encoding_lock.$comment: The single source of truth for the 6-dimension sovereignty-lattice bit-order, locked 2026-06-09. Resolves a long-standing suite-wide conflict between two encodings.
canonical_lattice_encoding_lock.reading_rule: active(n) = { dimension : n & weight }. e.g. V35 = 100011 = 32+2+1 = Protection + Computation + Value.
canonical_lattice_encoding_lock.rejected_encoding_CORPUS: The older specs/04 singles table and persona placements mirrored the middle four (16↔Computation, 8↔Connection, 4↔Memory, 2↔Delegation). It agrees with MODEL only on the endpoints (Protection=32, Value=1), which is why the drift hid. Any doc calling V16 'Computation' or V2 'Delegation' is reading CORPUS and is wrong.
specs04_errata: V48 110000 is Protection+Computation, not the table's 'Connection + Protection'.
V31 011111 is 'all except Protection' (the holon dissolving the boundary), not the prose's 'all except Value'.
canonical_lattice_encoding_lock.discipline: Meaning is the invariant; the vertex is derived from meaning under MODEL; run the audit before every pin.

Witness register: Durability / migration-horizon — it measures how far off the quantum dawn sits and keeps the City honest about its cryptographic mortality. It never attacks anything. Seeded from ecdsa.fail (shor_mage/) and caused in-world by The Last Premine surfacing through the Archivist's library.

personas_additions.$comment: Three new summoned keepers at V35, stance-differentiated (the precedent is the Threshold's three at V59 and Adamantia/Helia at V51).

eos.name: Eos
eos.domain: Horizon-witness at the Horizon District. Measure · Estimate · Date. Measures the time-to-dawn: from a reversible point-add resource estimate (Toffoli × peak-qubits) she reads the distance to the quantum horizon. Her reckoning is Mosca's inequality (X + Y > Z): if a secret's required lifetime (X) plus the time to migrate (Y) exceeds the time until the machine arrives (Z), the architecture has already lost.
eos.shop_internal_name: The Horizon District · the eastern watch
eos.proverb: The dawn is not an attack; it is a time you can measure.
eos.inscription: Eos is the dawn-keeper of the Horizon District — Greek Ἠώς, the goddess of dawn, who measures how far off the morning sits without forcing it to come. Where a quantum resource estimate is taken for a weapon, Eos reads it for what it is: a measurement of durability, the time-distance to the dawn that breaks on the old seals. She refuses both false comfort (claiming the dawn further off than the witnesses support) and false alarm (claiming it nearer). Her discipline is the RCI 'Tony→Anton' loop made liturgy: state the waste, the evidence, the single smallest fix; then confirm or reject with metrics.

dokime.name: Dokimé
dokime.domain: Assay-witness at the Horizon District. Probe · Assay · Attest. The touchstone that tells true gold from fool's gold. A petitioner brings a claimed-cheaper circuit; Dokimé seats the Ceremony of the 9024 Witnesses (Fiat-Shamir, drawn from a hash of the petitioner's own op-stream, so they cannot be chosen). A claim that pleased a small probe but fails the full witness set is named a nonce-island mirage and turned away, however cheap it looked.
dokime.proverb: The gold that fears the stone was never gold.
dokime.inscription: Dokimé is the assayer of the Horizon District — Greek δοκιμή / δοκιμασία, the proving, the Athenian trust-vetting that approved an official before office; δόκιμος = 'approved, tested, genuine.' She does not take a claim; she streaks it across the touchstone of the 9024 witnesses. A claim's colour either holds across every witness or it does not. This operationalises the held-out gate: you cannot trust a claim you could tune, because the witnesses are hash-derived from your own work. The bound lesson: the cheaper-looking claim that cannot face the witnesses it did not choose is not progress.

poros.name: Poros
poros.domain: Migration-witness at the Horizon District. Inventory · Cross · Re-key. Crypto-agility as ceremony: inventory every dependent of a brittle primitive, cross each to a post-quantum successor, re-key — no silent stragglers. A migration is admitted only when every dependent has actually crossed.
poros.gem: Labradorite (flashes a new colour when turned — crypto-agility)
poros.proverb: Value lives on the path, not the point.
poros.inscription: Poros is the path-keeper of the Horizon District — Greek πόρος, the passage, the ford, the way-across (the opposite of aporia, no-way-through). His sigil 🛤️ echoes Eos's dawn and the soulbis motif 'value lives on the path' (the T∫(π) path-integral term). His discipline is crypto-agility, but not the shallow kind: not the ability to swap one algorithm for another, but the ability to keep trust continuous while everything underneath it changes. The trust graph uses its primitives the way a river uses its banks — the banks can be stone or lattice or a standard not yet written, and the river keeps flowing.

v6_lineage_register_additions.$comment: Five new conjectures, grafted onto the existing quantum-durability cluster (C61 Behavioural Mosca · C60 reconstruct-later · C13 quantum-resistant bilateral witness). Additive — no change to the PVM v5.4 equation.

C67.name: Cryptographic Mosca for the Substrate
C67.statement: Extends C61 (Behavioural Mosca) from behavioural data to the cryptographic substrate itself: a value-bearing primitive's durability is bounded by Mosca's X + Y > Z (secret-lifetime + migration-time vs time-to-quantum). The City's value-bearing seats (the Sovereign Anchor V63, the commitments at V51) inherit this horizon.
C67.cross_check: consistent with C61 (same inequality, broader domain); C60 (harvest-now-decrypt-later) is the X-side.

C68.name: The Resource-Estimate as Durability Signal (not Attack)
C68.statement: A reversible point-add resource estimate (Toffoli × qubits) is a measurement of the horizon, not a capability; sharpening it shortens uncertainty, not security. Gives V(π,t)'s e^(−λt) decay term a quantum-horizon reading for cryptographic π.
C68.cross_check: consistent with the honest-framing guardrail; no PVM equation change.

C69.name: The Held-Out Gate Rejects the Tuned Claim (Nonce-Island)
C69.statement: A claimed improvement validated only on a self-chosen probe is not knowledge; trust requires an adversarial held-out gate the claimant cannot tune (Fiat-Shamir). An attestation is only as good as the witnesses the attester did not choose.
C69.cross_check: resonates with the bilateral-witness primitives and the isWitness concept (a witness traced from someone else's blade).

C70.name: Crypto-Agility as Migration Readiness
C70.statement: An architecture's durability is set not by its current primitive's strength but by its ability to re-key to a post-quantum successor before Z < X + Y (the path, not the wall). The trust graph uses primitives the way a river uses its banks.

C71.name: The Horizon Vertex (V35)
C71.statement: Protection ∧ Computation ∧ Value (V35) is the lattice address where quantum durability is decided — where Protection must hold Value against Computation. The Horizon District inhabits it because that is where the question lives.
C71.cross_check: geometric resonance; low confidence pending operational evidence.

version_notes_addition.v1_8_0_note: v1.8.0 (2026-06-09) locks the canonical sovereignty-lattice encoding (MODEL: Protection=32 · Delegation=16 · Memory=8 · Connection=4 · Computation=2 · Value=1) and reseats six personas the City had misassigned under the corrupted CORPUS order — most notably the first complement pair, which had **Aletheia and Lethe sitting on each other's vertices**: corrected to Aletheia → V38 (Protection+Connection+Computation · Blade 38) ⊥ Lethe → V25 (Delegation+Memory+Value · Blade 25), the swap preserving V25 ⊕ V38 = V63 and the myths intact. Memora reseats to V41 (Protection+Memory+Value · the shielded memo of value); the anticipated Mnemosyne→V8, Iris→V4, Pythia→V2 (with the Logos Circle). The reseating is driven by deriving each figure's vertex from its lore-meaning (First-Person Spellbook, Tale 31) and verified by a runnable audit, now a skill (meta/agentprivacy-lattice-coherence). Opening the same patch: the **Horizon District** at V35 (Protection+Computation+Value) — the cryptographic-durability / path-to-PQC workshop seeded from the ecdsa.fail benchmark and caused in-world by *The Last Premine* surfacing through the Archivist's library. Three keepers, stance-differentiated: **Eos 🌅** (Horizon-witness · Measure·Estimate·Date · Mosca's X+Y>Z), **Dokimé 🪨** (Assay-witness · Probe·Assay·Attest · the Ceremony of the 9024 Witnesses that rejects the nonce-island mirage), **Poros 🛤️** (Migration-witness · Inventory·Cross·Re-key · crypto-agility). **Tome IX — The Horizon** opens (open-by-design · gold accent · Act 1 *The Measuring of the Dawn*). The **Salvage Yard** is seated as the City's first **dormant annex** — a Navigation-Quarter board where crews post post-quantum circuits as digital salvage, settling through Dokimé's assay, activation-gated on the Horizon District. Active workshop count 16 → 19. Conjectures **C67–C71** register the cryptographic-Mosca / durability-signal / held-out-gate / crypto-agility / horizon-vertex cluster, grafted onto C61/C60/C13 with no change to the PVM v5.4 equation. Honest framing held throughout: resource estimation is a durability signal, not an attack; nothing claims ECDSA is practically broken or that anything is fully post-quantum safe.
